text: {"lessons":["I should avoid buying more just because a stock has risen; adding Stock E at a higher price increased my exposure before it fell.","I should make a clear, long-term plan rather than react to short-term price moves; selling Stocks D and E at losses and buying more Stock A did not prevent my account from declining.","I should keep enough cash and diversify thoughtfully, while remembering that a few months of results are too short to judge an investment strategy."]}
